boundary.scanned: SourceCurrentOriginalRowClusterScan.execute used (.scan pivot tail [] keptReversed) before = .yielded (.cluster next newKept) middle
boundary.nextMembers: ∀ edge ∈ next, edge ∈ (nodeEdges parent).filter (fun row => decide (row.entry.key.symbol = symbol))
boundary.midAdmission: ∀ (handle : Nat) (pair : Edge × Edge) (value : Edge), middle.memo.cells handle = some ⟨pair, .returned value⟩ → PairInputs (if pair.2.entry.identity < pair.1.entry.identity then (pair.2, pair.1) else pair)

recursive.done: SourceCurrentOriginalRowClusterScan.execute fuel (.cluster next newKept) middle = .done kept after
recursive.finalAdmission: ∀ (handle : Nat) (pair : Edge × Edge) (value : Edge), after.memo.cells handle = some ⟨pair, .returned value⟩ → PairInputs (if pair.2.entry.identity < pair.1.entry.identity then (pair.2, pair.1) else pair)

producer.otherDone: SourceCurrentOriginalRowClusterScan.execute otherFuel (.cluster ((nodeEdges parent).filter (fun row => decide (row.entry.key.symbol = symbol))) []) before = .done otherKept otherAfter
producer.otherAdmission: ∀ (handle : Nat) (pair : Edge × Edge) (value : Edge), otherAfter.memo.cells handle = some ⟨pair, .returned value⟩ → PairInputs (if pair.2.entry.identity < pair.1.entry.identity then (pair.2, pair.1) else pair)
